dema_bias.name: DEMA Bias
dema_bias.comment: Double EMA normalized by single EMA minus 1

tema_bias.name: TEMA Bias
tema_bias.comment: EMA divided by triple EMA minus 1

trix.name: TRIX
trix.comment: One-bar percent change of triple-smoothed EMA

aroon_up.name: Aroon Up
aroon_up.comment: Relative recency of rolling high on a 0-100 scale

aroon_down.name: Aroon Down
aroon_down.comment: Relative recency of rolling low on a 0-100 scale

vortex_plus.name: Vortex Plus
vortex_plus.comment: Rolling positive vortex movement divided by rolling true range

vortex_minus.name: Vortex Minus
vortex_minus.comment: Rolling negative vortex movement divided by rolling true range

regression_slope.name: Regression Slope
regression_slope.comment: Rolling linear-regression slope normalized by rolling mean close

hullma_bias.name: Hull MA Bias
hullma_bias.comment: Low-lag Hull-style EMA component divided by its sqrt-window EMA smoother minus 1

ichimoku_cloud_ratio.name: Ichimoku Cloud Ratio
ichimoku_cloud_ratio.comment: Ichimoku span A divided by span B using trend lookback multiples

ma_signal.name: Moving Average Signal
ma_signal.comment: Rolling-normalized close minus moving average trend signal

bbi_ratio.name: BBI Ratio
bbi_ratio.comment: Bull and Bear Index moving-average blend divided by close

bbi_bias.name: BBI Bias
bbi_bias.comment: Close divided by Bull and Bear Index minus 1

adxr_diff.name: ADXR Directional Difference
adxr_diff.comment: Lag-smoothed DI+ minus DI- directional trend spread

wma_ma_gap.name: WMA MA Gap
wma_ma_gap.comment: Weighted MA minus simple MA normalized by rolling absolute gap
